subject: Post-call recap + proposed pilot milestones & decision path
messages:
From: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>
To: Samir Khan <samir@brightcart.com>, Lisa Huang <lisa@brightcart.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 25 May 2026 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap + proposed pilot milestones & decision path

Thanks Samir and Lisa — good conversation today. Quick recap so we have a single source of truth and a proposed set of milestones/timeline to align on next steps. Please confirm any corrections or missing stakeholders.

Top pain points you described
- Current inference spend and latency spikes during peak search traffic (latency 600-900ms at 75th).
- Inability to host LLMs on your private VPC for compliance-sensitive personalization.
- Manual batch workflows causing throughput variability and operational overhead.

Goals we heard
- Reduce per-token inference unit cost by ~35-45% through better batching + quantization options.
- Achieve consistent 95th percentile latency under 250ms for the personalization endpoint.
- Run a 4-week pilot on dedicated capacity with integration to your VPC/role-based access for production validation.

Proposed Mutual Action Plan (initial)
1) Kickoff & scoping workshop — owner: Aisha (Redwood) / Samir (BrightCart) — target: week of 2026-06-07 — deliverable: scoping notes, data access list.
2) Security & compliance review — owner: Rafael (Redwood) / Monica (BrightCart) — target: 2026-06-10 — deliverable: SOC 2 evidence, network diagram, data retention policy.
3) Pilot deployment (dedicated pool, VPC peering) — owner: Infra Eng (Redwood) / Eng lead (BrightCart) — start: 2026-06-14 — duration: 4 weeks — deliverable: pilot runbook, performance report.
4) Eval & decision window — owners: Samir, Lisa, Aisha — target: decision by 2026-07-12 — criteria: cost per 1M tokens, latency SLO, ops readiness.

Decision process & stakeholders
- Technical sign-off: BrightCart Eng (Lisa) + Redwood infra lead (Rafael).
- Procurement/Legal: Monica Reyes (procurement) to complete SOW and contract redlines.
- Executive sponsor: Samir (final commercial sign-off).

Dependencies / open items
- Access: API keys and a small dataset sample for performance testing.
- Procurement contact (please confirm Monica's email).
- Security artifacts: SOC2 or equivalent — we can share a summary for review.

Attachments: BrightCart_MAP_v1.xlsx (proposed milestones), SOW_stub.pdf (high-level terms).

Action items for BrightCart
- Confirm procurement lead (name + email).
- Confirm pilot start window availability for engineering (week of 2026-06-14).

Action items for Redwood
- Share SOC2 summary and updated MAP after procurement contact is confirmed.
- Provide ballpark pricing ranges for Dedicated pilot + projected run-rate after pilot.

I'll update the MAP doc and circulate a v2 after I hear from you. Happy to jump on a 30m follow-up tomorrow if that helps.

Thanks,
Aisha Rahman
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 415-555-0198

From: Samir Khan <samir@brightcart.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>
Cc: Lisa Huang <lisa@brightcart.com>
Date: Tue, 26 May 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + proposed pilot milestones & decision path

Thanks Aisha — solid summary, appreciate the clarity. A few clarifications from our side: 
- The cost reduction target is closer to 40% on our existing production mix; please show ranges and which knobs produce the savings (batching vs quantization vs routing).
- We need the pilot start earlier if possible — our Q3 roadmap requires results before July. Can we aim to kick pilot on 2026-06-10 instead of 06-14?
- Procurement contact for contracts & SOW is Monica Reyes (monica.reyes@brightcart.com) — I'll loop her in once you confirm timelines.
- Can you provide SOC 2 summary/evidence up front? We need to triage any gaps before our security review.

I've attached our procurement checklist (procurement_requirements.pdf) that legal wants to see.

I'll also ask our Eng manager to allocate a couple of engineers for the first two weeks of the pilot.

—Samir
VP Product, BrightCart

On Mon, May 25, 2026 at 2:03 PM Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com> wrote:

Subject: Re: Post-call recap + proposed pilot milestones & decision path

Thanks Samir — great callouts. I've updated the plan below and attached a v2 of the MAP plus a SOC2 summary. Highlights: 
- Pilot start: moved to 2026-06-10 (we can actually spin Dedicated pool earlier once we have discovery answers).
- Procurement: added Monica as procurement owner (thanks for sending her email).
- Savings: provided ballpark ranges — see summary below. Full breakdown in attached MAP v2.

Ballpark pricing (high level)
- Dedicated pilot (4 weeks, 2x A100-equivalent capacity): $18k–$25k (pilot price range, includes 50% pilot discount).
- Projected run-rate for production after optimizations (model/quantization/batching): $6k–$10k per month for expected inference volume (subject to final configuration and sequence lengths).

Security artifacts
- SOC 2 summary attached (SOC2_certificate_summary.pdf). Full artifact package available under our security portal if you need deeper evidence: https://redwood.com/security/soc2-summary

Updated Mutual Action Plan (v2) — key dates
1) Scoping workshop — owner: Aisha/Samir — 2026-06-07 — DONE: agenda confirmed.
2) Security review & evidence exchange — owner: Rafael/Monica — target: 2026-06-10 — deliverable: signed NDA (if needed), SOC2 summary, network diagram.
3) Pilot deploy (Dedicated + VPC peering) — owner: Redwood infra / BrightCart Eng — start: 2026-06-10 — 4 weeks.
4) Performance eval & commercial decision — target: 2026-07-08 — deliverable: performance report + SOW ready for signature.

Next operational items I will do this week
- Upload BrightCart_MAP_v2.xlsx to the shared Drive folder and update HubSpot deal (link below).
- Draft SOW based on the pilot scope and share a DocuSign-ready version by 2026-06-02.

Proposed 30m sync: Wed 2026-05-27 10:00am PT — calendar invite here: https://calendly.com/aisha-redwood/brief-sync

Attachments: BrightCart_MAP_v2.xlsx, SOC2_certificate_summary.pdf, SOW_stub.pdf

Thanks,
Aisha Rahman
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Direct: +1 415-555-0198

Thanks both — this aligns with what we discussed. I'll loop Monica into procurement this afternoon and confirm whether legal needs any additional terms beyond the SOW stub.

On timing, our Eng manager tentatively confirmed availability for the week of 6/7 and can prioritize the 6/10 pilot start if procurement and security signoffs are on track. We'll confirm formally by Friday 2026-05-28.

Appreciate the clarity in the MAP v2 — please send the DocuSign-ready SOW when it's ready and I'll make sure procurement/legal have it on their list.

Best,
Lisa Huang
